text: I found Heather by chance on social media while I was trying to figure out a wedding gift for my cousin. She was extremely helpful and patient with everything and considering that I live in Australia she made things so easy. She managed to capture everything I wanted in the painting and offered more than I could ask for. Heather is definitely one of the sweetest people I've encountered and you can tell she has a deep routed passion for painting and art. The painting turned out stunning and my cousin loved how it turned out. Its a 6/5 stars for me and I hope to have her paint my wedding one day! :)
